title.en: Custom Anthropic-compatible endpoints can be verified
title.zh: 自定义 Anthropic 兼容地址可以正常验证

description.en: Verifying a custom Anthropic-compatible URL in Model access always failed with "Unknown provider", whatever address was entered. It is now checked like any other endpoint.
description.zh: 在「模型访问」中验证自定义 Anthropic 兼容地址时，无论填写什么地址都会提示「Unknown provider」。现在会与其他地址一样正常校验。

title.en: Agents can be set up with endpoints that don't list models
title.zh: 不提供模型列表的地址也能配置智能体

description.en: Many gateways and relays work fine but don't provide a model list. Setting up an agent with one of them used to hide the model field, so the agent could not be created. You can now enter a model name and test it; only a key the endpoint rejects stops setup. Model access also shows a note that the key couldn't be confirmed, instead of a red error.
description.zh: 许多网关和中转服务可以正常使用，但不提供模型列表。以往用这类地址配置智能体时，模型选择框会被隐藏，导致无法创建。现在可以直接填写模型名并测试，只有 Key 被拒绝时才会阻止配置。「模型访问」中也改为提示暂无法确认 Key，不再显示红色错误。

title.en: Workspace menu no longer stays over the settings page
title.zh: 工作区菜单不再残留在设置页上

description.en: Opening workspace settings or inviting members from the account menu could leave the menu stuck in the top-left corner of the settings page, covering its navigation. Menus and dialogs from the workspace now close properly when you move to settings.
description.zh: 从账号菜单进入工作区设置或邀请成员后，菜单可能会残留在设置页左上角，遮挡左侧导航。现在进入设置时，工作区中的菜单和弹窗都会正常收起。
